admission.justification: Immutable atomic creation prevents a resumed role reading an assignment silently rewritten under the original launch identity.

applicability: Creating the first-assignment files for a role launch.
conditions: The complete object is UTF-8 with a one-space indent and a final newline, and the projection's values equal the file's values at the same keys.
The receipt stores the complete file's path, canonical path, digest, size and its text.
exclusions: Lost-artifact reconstruction belongs to the saved-message retry contract.
statement: Every launch stores the compiled first message once as a plain-text hand-over artifact `<report path without its suffix>.handover.txt` and the complete hand-over object once as `<report path without its suffix>.handover.json`, each at most 1,048,576 bytes and created read-only (mode 0444) by a hard link of a finished temporary file: an existing file is reused only when it holds the same bytes, different content is refused and nothing changes, and a link at the file's own name is never followed. Both files are preflighted as one pair before either is written, and both exist before the start is sent.
